notes: «جميعا عن أبي عامر» : both co-transmitters meet at Abu Amir; «قال عبد حدثنا» is Abd's own wording of the same route
«سألت القاسم بن محمد» : Sa'd is the asker (already a link); Qasim, the one asked, answers and is a link (rule 5)
One saying: Qasim's answer and Aisha's report of the Prophet's words form one chain
